explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/224 (Danzer–Grünbaum): any 2^d + 1 points in ℝ^d contain three distinct points forming an obtuse angle, i.e. ⟨y - x, z - x⟩ < 0 at x. Collinear triples count, with the middle point giving angle π. That is the standard convention, and it handles d = 1. The d = 0 case is vacuous. Formal proof linked.
